notes: This is an in-process integration test: MSC 1 boots a real RemoteAPIServer on a real loopback TCP socket and drives it with actual HTTP requests, not a pure function call. 'tokenMap' is the fixed token/role/permission table every test in this source file shares (RemoteAPIIntegrationTestCase.tokenMap); 'token' fields in requests reference it by key, except literal invalid tokens used to test auth failure. Pins the S1 fix: file-read endpoints became admin-only, so a zero-permission named token is denied both /files and /files/read while still able to perform ordinary GETs like /status.
